tools.name: upload
tools.description: Upload a ZIP file to update an existing Chrome Web Store item draft. Returns success only when upload completion is confirmed; processing or unknown outcomes require status verification before publishing. Note: Creating new items via API is not supported in v2 — use the Developer Dashboard to create new items.

zipPath.description: Absolute path to the ZIP file to upload

itemId.description: Extension item ID (defaults to CWS_ITEM_ID env var)

publisherId.description: Publisher ID (defaults to CWS_PUBLISHER_ID env var or 'me')

tools.name: publish
tools.description: Publish an extension to Chrome Web Store. Supports immediate publish, staged publish, initial deploy percentage, block-on-warnings, and skip-review.

itemId.description: Extension item ID (defaults to CWS_ITEM_ID env var)

publisherId.description: Publisher ID (defaults to CWS_PUBLISHER_ID env var or 'me')

publishType.description: DEFAULT_PUBLISH: publishes immediately after approval. STAGED_PUBLISH: stages for manual publishing after approval. Defaults to DEFAULT_PUBLISH.

deployPercentage.description: Initial deploy percentage for staged rollout (0-100).

skipReview.description: Attempt to skip review if the extension qualifies. Defaults to false.

blockOnWarnings.description: If true, the publish is blocked when the submission has warnings. Defaults to false.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Fetch the current status of an extension on Chrome Web Store. Returns published/submitted revision status, deploy percentage, version, takedown/warning flags, and last upload state.

itemId.description: Extension item ID (defaults to CWS_ITEM_ID env var)

publisherId.description: Publisher ID (defaults to CWS_PUBLISHER_ID env var or 'me')

tools.name: cancel
tools.description: Cancel a pending submission on Chrome Web Store. Can be used to cancel an item currently in review.

itemId.description: Extension item ID (defaults to CWS_ITEM_ID env var)

publisherId.description: Publisher ID (defaults to CWS_PUBLISHER_ID env var or 'me')

tools.name: deploy-percentage
tools.description: Set the published deploy percentage for staged rollout on Chrome Web Store. The new percentage must be higher than the current target. Only available for items with 10,000+ seven-day active users.

percentage.description: Deploy percentage (0-100). Must be larger than the current target percentage.

itemId.description: Extension item ID (defaults to CWS_ITEM_ID env var)

publisherId.description: Publisher ID (defaults to CWS_PUBLISHER_ID env var or 'me')

tools.name: get
tools.description: Legacy listing metadata read. ⚠️ Legacy Chrome Web Store v1.1 metadata API (cutoff: 2026-10-15). After the cutoff this tool is blocked. Use 'status' for review/version/rollout information; read or change listing metadata in the Developer Dashboard. The v2 API has no metadata read/write endpoint.

itemId.description: Extension item ID (defaults to CWS_ITEM_ID env var)

projection.description: Metadata projection to fetch (defaults to DRAFT)

tools.name: update-metadata
tools.description: Legacy listing metadata update. ⚠️ Legacy Chrome Web Store v1.1 metadata API (cutoff: 2026-10-15). After the cutoff this tool is blocked. Use 'status' for review/version/rollout information; read or change listing metadata in the Developer Dashboard. The v2 API has no metadata read/write endpoint.

itemId.description: Extension item ID (defaults to CWS_ITEM_ID env var)

metadata.description: Raw metadata object forwarded as-is to the v1.1 API. Useful for fields not exposed as first-class params.

tools.name: submit
tools.description: One-shot submission: (optional preflight existence check) → upload the ZIP → verify the upload succeeded → publish for review → return the final status with a readable summary. Stops without publishing if upload completion is unconfirmed; check status and confirm the intended draft before using publish alone. No automatic polling.

zipPath.description: Absolute path to the ZIP file to upload and submit

itemId.description: Extension item ID (defaults to CWS_ITEM_ID env var)

publisherId.description: Publisher ID (defaults to CWS_PUBLISHER_ID env var or 'me')

publishType.description: DEFAULT_PUBLISH (default): publish immediately after approval. STAGED_PUBLISH: stage for manual publishing.

deployPercentage.description: Initial deploy percentage for staged rollout (0-100).

skipReview.description: Attempt to skip review if the extension qualifies. Defaults to false.

blockOnWarnings.description: If true, block the publish when the submission has warnings. Defaults to false.

preflight.description: Verify the item exists before uploading (default: true). Set false to skip the pre-check.

tools.name: reviews
tools.description: Fetch user reviews (rating, comment, author display name, create time) for a Chrome Web Store item, with pagination, sorting, and rating filter. Read-only.

itemId.description: Extension item ID (defaults to CWS_ITEM_ID env var)

publisherId.description: Publisher ID (defaults to CWS_PUBLISHER_ID env var or 'me')

pageSize.description: Maximum reviews to return (1-200). Defaults to at most 50.

pageToken.description: nextPageToken from a previous call. Keep all other parameters identical when paginating.

orderBy.description: Comma-separated sort fields: 'rating' (asc default, or 'rating desc') and 'create_time desc' (only desc; must be explicit). Example: 'create_time desc'.

filter.description: Filter expression. Only rating equality is supported, e.g. 'rating = 1'.

tools.name: rating-summary
tools.description: Fetch the rating summary of a Chrome Web Store item: average rating, total rating count, per-star counts, and number of reviews with text. Read-only.

itemId.description: Extension item ID (defaults to CWS_ITEM_ID env var)

publisherId.description: Publisher ID (defaults to CWS_PUBLISHER_ID env var or 'me')

tools.name: metrics
tools.description: Query store metrics for a Chrome Web Store item (installs, uninstalls, daily/7-day users, impressions, page views) over an optional date range, optionally sliced by one dimension (os, country, language, app-version, install-source, UTM, etc.). Read-only.

itemId.description: Extension item ID (defaults to CWS_ITEM_ID env var)

publisherId.description: Publisher ID (defaults to CWS_PUBLISHER_ID env var or 'me')

metrics.description: Metrics to query: installs, installs-7d, uninstalls, users (daily active), users-7d, impressions, page-views.

dimension.description: Optional single dimension to slice by (the API allows at most one).

firstDate.description: First date (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for no lower bound.

lastDate.description: Last date (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for no upper bound.

pageSize.description: Maximum rows to return (1-1000). Defaults to at most 100.

pageToken.description: nextPageToken from a previous call. Keep all other parameters identical when paginating.

tools.name: rollback
tools.description: Roll back the published package to a previously published version, re-published under a new higher version number. WARNING: a real rollback goes live to all users within about a minute without review, discards pending and staged submissions, and aborts ongoing percentage rollouts (reverting to the last version deployed at 100%). Repeated rollbacks cycle between the same two versions. Run with validateOnly=true first, and ensure the older version is compatible with data stored by the newer one.

itemId.description: Extension item ID (defaults to CWS_ITEM_ID env var)

publisherId.description: Publisher ID (defaults to CWS_PUBLISHER_ID env var or 'me')

newVersion.description: New version number for the re-published package. Must be higher than the currently published version (e.g. current 1.1 → 1.2).

rollbackReason.description: Reason for the rollback (recorded for auditing and shown in the Developer Dashboard).

targetCrxVersion.description: Previously published CRX version to roll back to. Defaults to the last published version.

validateOnly.description: If true, only validate (dry run) without rolling back. Recommended before a real rollback.
